whyItMatters: Without X-Frame-Options, any site can frame the page, letting an attacker overlay deceptive UI on real authenticated actions (clickjacking).
actions: Send X-Frame-Options: DENY on every HTML response (SAMEORIGIN only for intentional framing).
Add CSP frame-ancestors as the modern equivalent and keep both during migration.
Re-run a passive DAST scan to confirm the header is observed.
verification: A new passive DAST scan observes X-Frame-Options on the target's responses.
